title: Chartplotter bridge
description: Where the soundings the chartplotter records on this device's card are uploaded. They go to the Signal K server this device is connected to, with its access token, under this device's own vessel context.

keys.name: upload
keys.title: Upload new records
keys.description: Off keeps every record on the card and uploads nothing; progress stays where it is, so turning it back on later loses nothing.

keys.name: upload_path
keys.title: Upload path on the server
keys.description: Path appended to the Signal K server's address. Each POST carries one run of RealBathy records; a 2xx reply means the server has them.
